Well, is it possible to destroy loquipments (such as Palatial estate) with
'destroy equipmen' cards such as Shattering blow or something like that?

thanx
sead

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <5b2qkc$u...@argos.tel.hr>,

sdz...@alf.tel.hr (Sead Dzubur) wrote:
>
> Well, is it possible to destroy loquipments (such as Palatial estate) with
> 'destroy equipmen' cards such as Shattering blow or something like that?

No. The Location-equipment cards from DS and AH have errata stating that
they are not considered equipment once in play - they are only equipment
while the equip action is in progress. (The ones from Sabbat have explicit
card text explaining this).

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Rules Team Rulings: 1/12/96
Date: 14 Jan 1996 00:11:10 GMT
Message-ID: <4d9hmu$p...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

5) The equipment locations from Dark Sovereigns, such as Palatial Estate, do
not count as equipment while they are in play.

Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
Sead Dzubur (sdz...@alf.tel.hr) wrote:
: Well, is it possible to destroy loquipments (such as Palatial estate) with
: 'destroy equipmen' cards such as Shattering blow or something like that?

Loquipment was ruled as follows:

It is equip until it is actually equipped, at which point it becomes
a location...

i.e. you can't shattering blow a palatial estate because it is already
a "location" when you have the opportunity to shatter it.

Feel free to wait for more credible sources... :(

-spongy

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
jbwh...@dorsai.org (John Whelan) writes:
>: No. The Location-equipment cards from DS and AH have errata stating that
>: they are not considered equipment once in play - they are only equipment
>: while the equip action is in progress. (The ones from Sabbat have explicit
>: card text explaining this).

>Hmmm. Does this mean that Equiment-Locations cannot be transferred from

>one vampire to another by any means in the current game?

No. You can use Disputed Territory or <that dominate card that steals
locations> to take the locations from another Methuselah.

Anytime a new Meth. gets control of one of these locations, she places
it on one of her available minions/vampires.


